Kenney Jones's presence on drums marked the band's reinvention, while the MTV premiere context positioned the video as a founding artifact of music television itself. The understated black-and-white performance aesthetic aligns the clip with a sober, musician-first ethos at odds with the maximalist spectacle that would come to define 1980s MTV programming.

Its confirmed directorial credit (Wayne Isham), multiple verified location data points, and chart/commercial context make it an unusually well-documented specimen for scholarly and archival research.
